payload.title: File:Panoplosaurus teeth ROM 1215.png
payload.artist_html: Jordan C. Mallon, Jason S. Anderson
payload.description_html:
Figure 1. Overview of ankylosaur teeth. C, partial left maxillary tooth row of Panoplosaurus mirus (ROM 1215) in lingual view, exemplifying the distal shift in both tooth size and wear facet orientation (tooth positions numbered). [Cropped for use in Panoplosaurus page]

  • Mallon JC, Anderson JS (2014) The Functional and Palaeoecological Implications of Tooth Morphology and Wear for the Megaherbivorous Dinosaurs from the Dinosaur Park Formation (Upper Campanian) of Alberta, Canada. PLoS ONE 9(6): e98605. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0098605
